description:
Hi! I'm Kanchana S Valmiki, and our team, Moonshot Mappers, is building a map to find places on Earth that are like the Moon and Mars.

I'm interested in space, maps, and data, and I'm eager to learn coding and research along the way.

Our project helps NASA practice for future Moon and Mars bases. We'll compare things like temperature, ground type, and terrain, then show which places on Earth are the closest match on an easy map
